versions.name: Sega CD / Mega-CD
versions.summary: The first model of the Sega CD is designed to be under the Sega Genesis / Mega Drive. Different from the later revisions, this version has a mechanical disc tray, instead of being a top loading system.

versions.name: Sega CD Model 2 / Mega-CD II
versions.summary: A cost-reduced version of the Sega CD. It is a top loading console, standing besides the Sega Genesis / Mega Drive, instead of on top of it.
